name: @vsor/sor-site-theme
description: Docusaurus theme layer for VSoR sites — the design system and the chrome it paints: Tailwind v4 over an OKLCH token layer bridged onto the --ifm-* variables (src/css), the shadcn/ui primitives the chrome imports (src/ui), Navbar, Footer, Landing, LessonContent, DocPageActions, ReadingProgress, local-index SearchBar and ModeToggle. Copied from ag2 apps/learn-app at d764f334, stripped per specs/sor-site/surface/spec.md negative contract, de-branded. The tailwind/postcss/autoprefixer deps are runtime, not dev: this package configures the consuming site's postcss pipeline itself so a vsor project needs no postcss config of its own.
